title: fragcap target and attribution schema
description: The single versioned vocabulary for every machine-readable fragcap targeting and attribution artifact. One shared core, four kind-discriminated variants (profile, package, hint, export). Structural rules only; semantic invariants (acyclic descends_from, single terminal stage, role reachability, ambiguous image match) are enforced by the profile-load path, not by this schema.

kind.description: The artifact form. Selects which variant rules apply.

notes.description: Human-readable context carried as data, never as a comment.

stage.description: The stages that recognize this game's processes.

records.description: Export envelope: a batch of loose records. Present only when kind is export.

technologies.description: Technologies detected in the target's install directory, each a heuristic-unverified finding with the marker path that revealed it. Optional; a target may carry none.

launch.description: Steam launch configurations for this title, one entry per config.launch entry, carried whole. Hint-seeding metadata; never reduced to a single binary at seeding time (reducing to the socket holder is the resolver's runtime job).

launcher_mediated.description: True when Steam starts a publisher launcher that then starts the real client, so the invoked launch entry is not the socket-holding binary.

fidelity.description: Ordered trust tier the resolver reads: authored is highest, observed is a confirmed live result.

source.description: Origin, for example steam-appinfo, engine-rule, user.

seeded_at.description: When the record was generated or last refreshed.

id.description: Unique slug, used for resolution and as a filename component.

platform.description: Platform for managed launch, for example steam.

app_id.description: Platform application identifier, kept as a string.

capture.description: Capture defaults, all overridable on the command line.

match.description: Process-recognition predicates. At least one must be present.

path_contains.description: Case-insensitive substring of the full path.

path_regex.description: Regular expression over the full path.

stage.description: One role and how to recognize the processes that fill it.

role.description: Role name, unique within the document (uniqueness checked at profile load).

terminal.description: Whether this stage's exit ends capture. At most one per document (checked at profile load).

record.description: A loose record inside an export envelope. Carries its own fidelity and provenance.

launch_entry.description: One Steam launch configuration (a config.launch entry). The invoked binary for a launcher-mediated title is a publisher launcher, not the socket holder; the entry records what Steam declares.

os.description: Operating-system filter, as Steam declares it.

engine.description: Engine attribution with its provenance and confidence. A within-record grading of one heuristic field, distinct from the record fidelity: a low engine confidence does not lower the record's overall trust.

name.description: The attributed engine name; absent when the lookup did not settle on one.

source.description: Where the engine attribution came from.

confidence.description: Confidence in the engine attribution; a within-field gradation, not a fidelity tier.

technology.description: One detected technology: a category, a name, the marker path that matched, and a heuristic fidelity.

name.description: Technology name (the ruleset key as a readable label).

marker_path.description: Relative install-directory path of a representative file that matched.
